name: v1.14.0
body:
## What's Changed

### Added

* Extract and display web links from (Markdown) text content by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/347
* Add tests for extracting urls from Markdown content and extract unique URLs only by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/351

### Bug Fixes

* Fix menus where the accent border was missing by @Togtja in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/342

### Minor

* Bump gitpython from 3.1.58 to 3.1.59 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/348 

### Documentation

* JT-76: Update the website with a new template by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/344
* JT-76: Update the website `og` meta tag with logo by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/345
* JT-78: fix images in readme by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/349
* JT-79: update image in website by @whyisdifficult in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/350

## New Contributors
* @Togtja made their first contribution in https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/pull/342

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/whyisdifficult/jiratui/compare/v1.13.1...v1.14.0
